title: introduce-rotatable-secret-sidecar-and-staged-rollout-windows-in-private-values-schema
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Private deployments need an operationally safe way to rotate TLS and API credentials without cluster restarts or large-scale tenant disruption. This PR adds a rotatable secret sidecar pattern to the private Helm chart, plus a staged rollout window concept and an immutable-values enforcement flag to make secret updates predictable for operators. Changes are conservative: the sidecar is opt-in, values are guarded by a strict schema, and rollout windows default to a no-op behavior unless configured. This single-string description includes the change list, upgrade guidance, and rollout notes. Changes: 1) charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json - add 'secretRotation' top-level block with fields: enabled, mode (sidecar|initJob), window (cron-like cadence), maxUnavailablePct, immutableValues (bool), and preflightProbe settings. 2) charts/redwood-private/templates/secret-rotation-sidecar.yaml - new helper template that injects a sidecar container when secretRotation.mode=sidecar; container reads KMS-backed secret provider and writes to shared volume with file locks. 3) charts/redwood-private/templates/rollout-window-configmap.yaml - a small template that converts the window settings into a configmap consumed by the operator init hook. 4) charts/redwood-private/templates/preflight-pod.yaml - optional preflight job that verifies permissions and KMS connectivity; runs when preflightProbe.enabled is true. 5) charts/_helpers.tpl - helpers for rendering percent-to-count and for honoring immutable-values semantics during upgrades. 6) values.yaml - documented examples for stage, prod, and airgapped environments. Upgrade guidance: operators should first install with secretRotation.enabled=false, validate preflightProbe against KMS endpoint, then flip to sidecar mode in a small tenant subset using head_branch rollout policy (example provided in chart docs). Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged (secretRotation.enabled=false). Security: secret lifecycle is WAL-logged (audit annotations) and sidecar runs with minimal RBAC; values.schema enforces length/regex constraints for window expressions. See release notes for known limitations (airgapped environments require an alternate provider).

release_notes:
- Added rotatable secret sidecar pattern for private deployments (opt-in).
- Introduced staged rollout windows to control secret update blast radius.
- Added preflight KMS validation job and stricter values.schema for secretRotation.
- New values: secretRotation.enabled, secretRotation.mode, secretRotation.window, secretRotation.maxUnavailablePct, secretRotation.immutableValues, secretRotation.preflightProbe.
Operators: start with secretRotation.enabled=false and run preflight checks before enabling in production.
